name: Instrument: Build the counsel questions register, counsel's one-sentence card, and the separation rows on the parameters register (gated on `86ajgn2z5`)
text_content:
I10, I11, and I15, extending Session 13's parameters register (17tn048qeu4) in form and content and Session 14's flag record (17tn048qfnq). The register as A12 specifies. The card: counsel's sentence a lead says before a person continues a report, in every house language, with the flag's path by reference and nothing else, refusing a lead's own wording, a promise counsel has not written, and a second sentence; carried by every lead and founder. The rows: "separation payment, if any" owned by the founders with counsel and recommended as one rule for every departure of the second and third kinds if set; the hold pay rule owned by the founders with counsel; and the reduction's counts owned by the founders at the reset; each named, owned, set against its source, and unset, read by the mechanics page as "being finalized" until set, refusing any value in this program, a per-person value, and a negotiation field. Lives on the partners' page and the lead's card set; owned by the founders with counsel and the Operations Lead for the record. Gated on 86ajgn2z5, 17tn048qeu4, counsel engaged (A9), and the definitions of toxicity and exploitation for the card. Financials are not a context source for this program. Urgent.

Filed by Session 15 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmjpw. Reasoning lives on the S15 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.

comment.text:
Extended by Session 16. Six questions join the register continuing Session 15's numbering, each stated so counsel can answer it without the page: 26, whether the founders are employees for any purpose and whether a founder working a service under a designation is working as one; 27, whether the house's flag path may run with a founder as subject and what the record and the line may hold about a founder; 28, whether the partners' exclusion from the pool has any consequence for the pool's character as a wage, extending question 4 and the parked carryover; 29, what the house must do at a founder's departure, incapacity, or death regarding records, authorities, accounts, and the interim's lawful holders; 30, whether the founders' documents, the ledger, and the load line are records with retention, discovery, disclosure, or fiduciary consequence; 31, whether commitments outside the house held by any founder raise any duty under the agreement or the law, stated generically. Urgency: 26 and 30 before the first founder-held check-in, 27 before the first flag read, 28 before the first pay page, 29 and 31 before dinner's gate (S16 section 16, P55). No question asks for a figure.
